sentences: This describes a AirportCode entity in the domain.
The AirportCode record participates in downstream tool operations.
AirportCode.iata: IATA code
AirportCode.city: City name
This describes a Name entity in the domain.
The Name record participates in downstream tool operations.
Name.first_name: The person's first name
Name.last_name: The person's last name
This describes a Address entity in the domain.
The Address record participates in downstream tool operations.
Address.address1: Primary address line
Address.address2: Secondary address line (optional)
Address.city: City name
Address.country: Country name
This describes a Payment entity in the domain.
The Payment record participates in downstream tool operations.
Payment.payment_id: Unique identifier for the payment
Payment.amount: Payment amount in dollars
This describes a PaymentMethodBase entity in the domain.
The PaymentMethodBase record participates in downstream tool operations.
PaymentMethodBase.source: Type of payment method
PaymentMethodBase.id: Unique identifier for the payment method
A CreditCard is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The CreditCard record participates in downstream tool operations.
CreditCard.source: Indicates this is a credit card payment method
CreditCard.brand: Credit card brand (e.g., visa, mastercard)
CreditCard.last_four: Last four digits of the credit card
A GiftCard is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The GiftCard record participates in downstream tool operations.
GiftCard.source: Indicates this is a gift card payment method
GiftCard.amount: Gift card value amount
GiftCard.id: Unique identifier for the gift card
A Certificate is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The Certificate record participates in downstream tool operations.
Certificate.source: Indicates this is a certificate payment method
Certificate.amount: Certificate value amount
This describes a Passenger entity in the domain.
The Passenger record participates in downstream tool operations.
Passenger.first_name: Passenger's first name
Passenger.last_name: Passenger's last name
Passenger.dob: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format
This describes a FlightDateStatusAvailable entity in the domain.
The FlightDateStatusAvailable record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDateStatusAvailable.status: Indicates flight is available for booking
FlightDateStatusAvailable.available_seats: Available seats by class
FlightDateStatusAvailable.prices: Current prices by class
This describes a FlightDataStatusOnTime entity in the domain.
The FlightDataStatusOnTime record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDataStatusOnTime.status: Indicates flight is on time
FlightDataStatusOnTime.estimated_departure_time_est: Estimated departure time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T06:04:00
FlightDataStatusOnTime.estimated_arrival_time_est: Estimated arrival time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T07:30:00
This describes a FlightDataStatusFlying entity in the domain.
The FlightDataStatusFlying record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDataStatusFlying.status: Indicates flight is in flight
FlightDataStatusFlying.actual_departure_time_est: Actual departure time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T06:04:00
FlightDataStatusFlying.estimated_arrival_time_est: Estimated arrival time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T07:30:00
This describes a FlightDateStatusLanded entity in the domain.
The FlightDateStatusLanded record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDateStatusLanded.status: Indicates flight has landed
FlightDateStatusLanded.actual_departure_time_est: Actual departure time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T06:04:00
FlightDateStatusLanded.actual_arrival_time_est: Actual arrival time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T07:30:00
This describes a FlightDateStatusCancelled entity in the domain.
The FlightDateStatusCancelled record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDateStatusCancelled.status: Indicates flight was cancelled
This describes a FlightDateStatusDelayed entity in the domain.
The FlightDateStatusDelayed record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDateStatusDelayed.status: Indicates flight was delayed
FlightDateStatusDelayed.estimated_departure_time_est: Estimated departure time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T06:04:00
FlightDateStatusDelayed.estimated_arrival_time_est: Estimated arrival time in EST in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g 2024-05-15T07:30:00
This describes a FlightBase entity in the domain.
The FlightBase record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightBase.flight_number: Unique flight identifier
FlightBase.origin: IATA code for origin airport
FlightBase.destination: IATA code for destination airport
A Flight is a kind of FlightBase.
The Flight record participates in downstream tool operations.
Flight.scheduled_departure_time_est: Scheduled departure time in EST in the format HH:MM:SS, e.g 06:00:00
Flight.scheduled_arrival_time_est: Scheduled arrival time in EST in the format HH:MM:SS, e.g 07:00:00
Flight.dates: Flight status by date (YYYY-MM-DD)
A DirectFlight is a kind of FlightBase.
The DirectFlight record participates in downstream tool operations.
DirectFlight.status: Indicates flight is available for booking
DirectFlight.scheduled_departure_time_est: Scheduled departure time in EST in the format HH:MM:SS, e.g 06:00:00
DirectFlight.scheduled_arrival_time_est: Scheduled arrival time in EST in the format HH:MM:SS, e.g 07:00:00
DirectFlight.date: Flight date in YYYY-MM-DD format
A ReservationFlight is a kind of FlightBase.
The ReservationFlight record participates in downstream tool operations.
ReservationFlight.date: Flight date in YYYY-MM-DD format
ReservationFlight.price: Flight price in dollars.
This describes a FlightInfo entity in the domain.
The FlightInfo record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightInfo.flight_number: Flight number, such as 'HAT001'.
FlightInfo.date: The date for the flight in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2024-05-01'.
This describes a User entity in the domain.
The User record participates in downstream tool operations.
User.user_id: Unique identifier for the user
User.name: User's full name
User.address: User's address information
User.email: User's email address
This describes a Reservation entity in the domain.
The Reservation record participates in downstream tool operations.
Reservation.reservation_id: Unique identifier for the reservation
Reservation.user_id: ID of the user who made the reservation
Reservation.origin: IATA code for trip origin
Reservation.destination: IATA code for trip destination
This describes a FlightDB entity in the domain.
The FlightDB record participates in downstream tool operations.
FlightDB.flights: Dictionary of all flights indexed by flight number
FlightDB.users: Dictionary of all users indexed by user ID
FlightDB.reservations: Dictionary of all reservations indexed by reservation ID
This tool books User to produce a Reservation.
Invoke book_reservation when the user needs to book a Reservation.
Book a reservation.
This tool calculates a request to produce a str.
Invoke calculate when the user needs to calculate a str.
Calculate the result of a mathematical expression.
This tool cancels Reservation to produce a Reservation.
Invoke cancel_reservation when the user needs to cancel a Reservation.
Cancel the whole reservation.
This tool gets Reservation to produce a Reservation.
Invoke get_reservation_details when the user needs to get a Reservation.
Get the details of a reservation.
This tool gets User to produce a User.
Invoke get_user_details when the user needs to get a User.
Get the details of a user, including their reservations.
This tool lists a request to produce a AirportInfo.
Invoke list_all_airports when the user needs to list a AirportInfo.
Returns a list of all available airports.
This tool searchs a request to produce a DirectFlight.
Invoke search_direct_flight when the user needs to search a DirectFlight.
Search for direct flights between two cities on a specific date.
This tool searchs a request to produce a DirectFlight.
Invoke search_onestop_flight when the user needs to search a DirectFlight.
Search for one-stop flights between two cities on a specific date.

Send a certificate to a user. Be careful!

Invoke transfer_to_human_agents when the user needs to transfer a str.
Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
This tool updates Payment and Reservation to produce a Reservation.
Invoke update_reservation_baggages when the user needs to update a Reservation.
Update the baggage information of a reservation.
This tool updates Payment and Reservation to produce a Reservation.
Invoke update_reservation_flights when the user needs to update a Reservation.
Update the flight information of a reservation.

Invoke update_reservation_passengers when the user needs to update a Reservation.
Update the passenger information of a reservation.

Invoke get_flight_status when the user needs to get a str.
Get the status of a flight.
